newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher, seen consolidating gains.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher, seen consolidating gains.

text.p: UK shares opened modestly higher on Wednesday after leading shares soared to their highest-ever levels on Tuesday amid euphoria over the new government's decision to grant the Bank of England freedom to set interest rates without political interference.
The FTSE 100 index was up 3.3 points at 4,522.6 by 0742 GMT, just a few points shy of its all-time high of 4,525.6, set yesterday. Gainers were in a five-to-three majority.
"There was a lot of news yesterday which needs to be digested, said one trader. "What do we do for an encore?..We'll probably see some consolidation today."
